text:
I went on undressing you of yourself,

of the superimposed "yous" that life

had fitted around you...


I tore away the bark-whole and hard-

that believed itself fruit, that had

the shape of fruit.


And before the vague astonishment of your eyes

you emerged with your eyes still veiled

in darkness and astonishments...


You emerged from yourself; from your own

fertile shadow-intact and torn

into living soul...

translation.title: I Went On Undressing You...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the stripping away of false selves until the living soul emerges.
